ideas.pitch: Real-time carbon footprint optimization and route emission monitoring dashboard tailored for large educational campuses like DTU.
ideas.title: DTU Campus Carbon & Transit Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven pattern from logistics optimization hacks by delivering concrete, measurable environmental metrics that appeal to institutional judges.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage web app featuring rPPG heart rate sensing via web camera and multi-language health guidance for fast campus medical support.
ideas.title: MediScan DTU: Student Triage & Wellness Hub

ideas.pitch: AI-powered scheduling application that coordinates local community outreach and transport sharing for elderly residents using student volunteer drivers.

ideas.pitch: A localized multilingual health awareness assistant offering preventive care insights and outbreak tracking for rural and semi-urban communities.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data agent that monitors internal system logs, detects anomalies, verifies root causes, and generates automated pull requests for fixes.
